dcDescription:
1937.06.0006 San Carlos, Arizona. U.S.A. (jmf. 37.6.2) San Carlos, Arizona, Nordamerika [[Haga]] San Carlos, Arizona skiss Apacher Amerika United States Apacher Apache tribe Korfat.  Köpt.
San Carlos Apache coiled tray basket. The conventionalized floral design is fairly characteristic. Note that the encircling line is broken near the end of the coil on the rim- the common practice of leaving an 
opening, sometimes said to be so as to prevent the spirit of the maker from being cought in the design. The yellow may be yucca, as an effect similar to this colout is secured by the Mescalero Apaches

cultural.vision_reason: A twined sumac burden basket with buckskin fringe, black martynia decoration and white cottonwood border, documented as made by a named San Carlos Apache woman and purchased directly at the San Carlos Apache Fair — a classic Apache-made utilitarian basket.
